LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_Combatant.label: combatant training
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_Combatant.description: Training general combat skills. Basic bonuses begin at 20%; proficient bonuses and ongoing damage reduction begin at 50%. The reduced mental break threshold also applies outside combat. Shooting accuracy and melee hit bonuses modify raw ratings, not final probability percentage points. Completing ordinary training retains proficient bonuses and grants no special ability.
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_Combatant.stages.0.label: combatant in training
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_Combatant.stages.1.label: basic combatant
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_Combatant.stages.2.label: proficient combatant
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_Combatant_Final.label: final combatant
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_Combatant_Final.description: A permanent combat specialization obtained by processing and implanting personality gel. Increases raw shooting and melee hit ratings, reduces aiming time and melee cooldown, lowers the everyday mental break threshold, and multiplies incoming damage by 0.80. Replaces ordinary combatant bonuses and survives direction changes, unbinding, and chain regression. It leaves the old body with the extracted personality. Unlocks Combat Overdrive while drafted: six combat bonuses for 1 in-game hour, with a 4-hour cooldown.
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_CombatOverdrive.label: combat overdrive
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_CombatOverdrive.description: Temporary final-combatant enhancement: melee damage ×1.30, melee cooldown ×0.75, ranged cooldown ×0.80, incoming damage ×0.75, movement speed ×1.25, and pain ×0.50. Lasts 1 in-game hour. Undrafting does not cancel it; personality extraction or replacement removes it, and it does not transfer.
